title: Quicknode Now Supports Robinhood Chain Mainnet | Quicknode
summary: Quicknode now supports Robinhood Chain, the Arbitrum Orbit Ethereum L2 for tokenized stocks, ETPs, and RWAs. Spin up an RPC endpoint and start building.
body_markdown:
-


**Tokenized asset trading.** Build DEXs and AMMs optimized for tokenized equities, ETPs, and RWAs. With 100ms blocks and Chainlink price feeds, onchain order execution can rival traditional exchanges, with 24/7 availability and self-custody.


-


**DeFi with RWA collateral.** Deploy lending protocols and yield platforms where tokenized stocks and treasuries serve as collateral, unlocking capital efficiency that crypto-only collateral pools cannot reach.


-


**Onchain brokerage infrastructure.** Build settlement and clearing systems that run around the clock. Robinhood Chain removes the T+1 settlement delay of traditional markets, enabling real-time finality.


-


**Consumer finance apps.** Ship fintech products with embedded onchain rails. ERC-4337 smart wallets with gas sponsorship abstract away blockchain complexity, so users interact with a familiar interface while assets settle onchain.


-


**Perpetual futures and derivatives.** Build onchain derivatives platforms for tokenized assets with the low-latency execution trading applications demand.
